## History

Dillon established himself as a shrewd sailor working throughout the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific). During his career at sea, he became the first individual to discover unmistakable physical evidence of the wrecks. This discovery solidified his reputation as a capable and observant mariner.
